func (db *DB) CreateTaskWithSequence(ctx context.Context, projectID int64, projectName string, task Task, occupied func(int) (bool, error)) (int64, int, error) {
	return db.createTaskWithSequence(ctx, projectID, projectName, task, "", 0, occupied, nil, 0)
}

func (db *DB) CreateTaskWithSequenceAndIntent(ctx context.Context, projectID int64, projectName string, task Task, command string, processID int, occupied func(int) (bool, error)) (int64, int, error) {
	return db.createTaskWithSequenceAndIntentWithinLimit(ctx, projectID, projectName, task, command, processID, 0, occupied)
}

func (db *DB) CreateTaskWithSequenceAndIntentWithinLimit(ctx context.Context, projectID int64, projectName string, task Task, command string, processID, maxWorkers int, occupied func(int) (bool, error)) (int64, int, error) {
	return db.createTaskWithSequenceAndIntentWithinLimit(ctx, projectID, projectName, task, command, processID, maxWorkers, occupied)
}

func (db *DB) createTaskWithSequenceAndIntentWithinLimit(ctx context.Context, projectID int64, projectName string, task Task, command string, processID, maxWorkers int, occupied func(int) (bool, error)) (int64, int, error) {
	if command == "" || processID < 1 {

A reply is not a review pass or a User answer |
docs/spec.md-811- | `posse pr refresh <task>` | sets the saved or Brief title and rewrites Posse's Validation block inside its tokenized span | requires a current open observation; other PR/MR text is unchanged; already-current metadata is recorded without an edit |
docs/spec.md:812: | `posse pr rerun <task> --run <id>` (GitHub) or `--job <id>` (GitLab) | reruns the failed jobs of an existing CI run (`gh run rerun --failed`, `glab ci retry`) | the id must be a failed check on the current observed head, the run must have completed on that head, and each run is rerun at most twice per head (`pr_rerun_limit`); it never starts a workflow, dispatches a new one or changes code |

docs/spec.md-814- A forge error after an effect was requested records the operation `uncertain` and returns retryable `forge_outcome_unknown`. A `pending` operation older than two minutes belongs to an interrupted command and is treated the same way. The next attempt of the same operation first observes the forge: a reply is found by its marker, a GitHub rerun by a later run attempt or a running status, a GitLab rerun by a newer job of the same name in the pipeline.
